name: Shee (S)
description: Shee (S) is a jounin of the Hidden Cloud Village and a sensor. Shee is one of the Raikage's most reliable shinobi.

skills.name: Sensor Awareness
skills.description: Shee uses his sensor, dealing 25 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if a new harmful skill is used on Shee, he will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ally Heal
skills.description: Using Ally Heal, Shee heals himself or an ally for 25 health.

skills.name: Lightning Illusion Flash
skills.description: Shee blinds one enemy with a lightning-based illusion, dealing 35 damage to them and making them invulnerable to helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Defensive Reaction
skills.description: This skill makes Shee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.
